verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents monitors that watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a recurring schedule and send signed change events, which is a genuine autonomous background automation. It also offers async background batch crawls, though those are one-off jobs rather than recurring schedules. The automation scope is limited to change-monitoring, and the evidence is a single summary line. missing for 10: general-purpose or configurable automation workflows beyond page monitoring, detail on schedule configuration and triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and receive signed change events.
Crawl up to 25,000 pages in a background batch, track progress, and retrieve Markdown or HTML when the job finishes.
